zh: AI 报表全面支持交互单元格编辑、局部微调与历史记录，优化只读模式与图表呈现。
图表指标标线与阈值标签智能靠上定位，保证关键数据与目标参考线清晰易读。
新增内置与定制工具独立纯净窗口导航机制，外链与新开标签页不再嵌套冗余平台外壳。
首页对话新增侧轨与底栏折叠组件，大幅提升多会话切换与沉浸式操作体验。
优化工具页面平台主题与滚动条注入顺序，完善多端兼容性与全量自动化校验。
en: Added interactive cell editing, localized prompt adjustments, and execution history for AI reports.
Positioned chart target thresholds and reference lines for clearer data readout without overlapping.
Introduced standalone clean-window navigation for built-in and custom tools, removing redundant nested shells.
Added foldable conversation rail and bottom dock on the home screen to streamline multi-chat workflows.
Refined theme and scrollbar injection order across tools with comprehensive automated verification.
